aboutFounder.title: Meet Dr. Sandeep Bariki
aboutFounder.subtitle: Personalized, compassionate dental care built around trust, comfort, and long-term oral health.
aboutFounder.p1: At our private practice, Dr. Sandeep Bariki is committed to delivering truly personalized dental care built around each patient’s unique needs, comfort, and long-term oral health. With over a decade of clinical experience practicing in the United States and a strong international educational foundation, Dr. Bariki combines advanced clinical expertise with a compassionate, patient-centered philosophy.
aboutFounder.p2: Dr. Bariki began his dental journey by earning his Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) degree in India before pursuing advanced education in the United States. He completed a Master’s degree in Health Informatics from Saint Louis University and later earned his Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) degree from the University of Southern California (USC) in 2016.
aboutFounder.p3: In his private practice, Dr. Bariki focuses on comprehensive oral health — from preventive care and routine checkups to advanced restorative and implant dentistry. By offering a full spectrum of services under one roof, he strives to make dental care convenient, complete, and comfortable for every patient.
aboutFounder.p4: Known for his gentle approach and calm chairside manner, Dr. Bariki prioritizes patient comfort and clear communication. His goal is to build lasting relationships based on trust, education, and exceptional care.
aboutFounder.welcomeTitle: A Personal Welcome from Dr. Sandeep Bariki
aboutFounder.w1: Welcome, and thank you for choosing our dental family. As the owner and dentist of this practice, my goal is simple — to create a place where patients feel genuinely cared for, respected, and confident about their oral health.
aboutFounder.w2: Dentistry is not just about treating teeth; it’s about building lasting relationships with the families and individuals we serve here in our Dallas community.
aboutFounder.w3: Whether you’re visiting for a routine checkup, restorative treatment, or a complete smile transformation, my team and I are committed to delivering high-quality care in a friendly, welcoming environment.

hero.title: Why Choose Invisalign®
hero.p1: A confident smile should feel natural — not forced, not hidden, and not uncomfortable. At Dallas Smiles Dental & Orthodontics, we offer Invisalign® as a modern orthodontic solution designed for people who want straighter teeth without disrupting their lifestyle.
hero.p2: Unlike traditional braces, Invisalign uses a series of custom-made, clear aligners that gradually guide your teeth into their ideal position. These aligners are virtually invisible, comfortable to wear, and removable — giving you the flexibility that metal braces simply cannot offer.

doctor.title: Personalized Invisalign Treatment
doctor.p1: Dr. Sandeep Bariki carefully evaluates each patient’s bite, alignment, and facial harmony to create a personalized digital treatment plan.
doctor.p2: Using advanced 3D imaging technology, you can even preview how your smile is expected to look before treatment begins.

conditions.title: Invisalign Can Treat
conditions.subtitle: Invisalign aligners are designed to treat many common orthodontic problems comfortably and discreetly.
conditions.bottom: Whether you're a busy professional, a teen involved in activities, or an adult who never had braces growing up, Invisalign allows you to improve your smile discreetly and comfortably.

c1.title: Crowded Teeth
c1.desc: Teeth overlap because there isn't enough room in the jaw.

c2.title: Spacing Issues
c2.desc: Gaps between teeth caused by missing teeth or jaw size.

c3.title: Overbite
c3.desc: Upper teeth overlap too much over the lower teeth.

c4.title: Underbite
c4.desc: Lower teeth extend past the upper teeth when biting.

c5.title: Crossbite
c5.desc: Some upper teeth sit inside the lower teeth instead of outside.

c6.title: Alignment Concerns
c6.desc: Invisalign can treat mild to moderate alignment issues.

kids.title: Invisalign for Kids & Teenagers
kids.p1: Invisalign is a great orthodontic option for kids and teenagers who want a comfortable and nearly invisible way to straighten their teeth. Unlike traditional braces, Invisalign aligners are made from clear, smooth plastic that fits comfortably over the teeth and gradually moves them into proper alignment.
kids.p2: Because the aligners are removable, kids and teens can easily take them out while eating, brushing, and flossing. This helps maintain better oral hygiene and allows them to continue enjoying their favorite foods without restrictions.
kids.p3: Invisalign is especially popular among teenagers because it allows them to straighten their teeth discreetly while staying confident in school, sports, and social activities.

braces.title: Advanced Dental Braces for a Perfect Smile
braces.p1: Dental braces are a highly effective solution for correcting misaligned teeth, bite issues, and overcrowding. Our customized orthodontic treatments are designed to gradually move your teeth into the ideal position for a healthier and more confident smile.
braces.p2: We offer modern braces options that are comfortable, efficient, and suitable for both teens and adults. Our expert team ensures precise adjustments and continuous monitoring throughout your treatment journey.

b1.title: Nearly Invisible Appearance
b1.desc: Clear aligners blend naturally with your teeth so most people won’t notice treatment.

b2.title: Comfortable Fit
b2.desc: Smooth BPA-free plastic aligners eliminate irritation from wires and brackets.

b3.title: Removable Aligners
b3.desc: Remove aligners while eating, brushing, and flossing for better oral hygiene.

b4.title: Fewer Office Visits
b4.desc: Appointments are shorter and less frequent compared to traditional braces.

b5.title: Predictable Digital Planning
b5.desc: Advanced digital scanning allows you to preview your future smile.

b6.title: Confidence During Treatment
b6.desc: Discreet aligners let you smile confidently during treatment.

b7.title: Customized Treatment
b7.desc: Every Invisalign plan is tailored to your facial structure and dental health.

trust.title: Why Patients Trust Dallas Smiles
trust.p1: At Dallas Smiles Dental & Orthodontics, Invisalign is not a one-size-fits-all treatment. Dr. Bariki combines over a decade of clinical experience with advanced continuing education to ensure your treatment is efficient, precise, and stable long-term.
trust.p2: We focus not only on straight teeth — but on balanced bites, healthy gums, and a smile that enhances your overall facial aesthetics.

payment.title: Flexible Monthly Payment Plans
payment.p1: We understand that every patient’s financial situation is different. Our team will review your treatment plan with full transparency and help you choose a payment structure that works best for you.
payment.p2: Whether you prefer a lower upfront cost or manageable monthly installments, we will customize an option that aligns with your needs.

cherry.title: Cherry – Our Official Financing Partner
cherry.p1: To make Invisalign even more affordable, we proudly partner with Cherry, our official patient financing provider.
cherry.b4: Options for qualifying patients, including promotional plans
cherry.p2: The application process is straightforward and can often be completed in just minutes. Our team will guide you through every step to ensure a smooth experience.

final.title: Affordable Invisalign with Flexible Financing
final.p1: A straighter smile should be accessible — not stressful. That’s why Dallas Smiles offers flexible payment plans designed to fit comfortably within your budget.
final.p2: We proudly partner with Cherry, our official patient financing provider, offering fast applications, quick approval decisions, and convenient monthly payment plans.
